parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Header-auth webhook (`X-BookLeaf-Key`). Bubble sends the author's **full payload** (Bubble Free plan cannot expose a Data API). Payload is validated and de-duplicated per author; bad requests get 400, duplicates 409.

## 2 · AI
Deterministic facts (totals, payout dates, overdue/threshold scenario) are computed in code; Claude only writes. Output is checked for name, pending total, production updates and invented ₹ amounts.

## 3 · Output & status
SMTP email (bonus), then the **response to Bubble's request** carries status Success/Failed, the email, timestamp and execution id. Every error output converges on **Build failure response**.
